openings.claim: Preventing unrecorded location changes will reduce second-location searches and delayed pickups if stale exceptions are a major cause.
openings.delta: Replace the once-before-opening exception slip with a movement rule: the existing clerk writes the destination on the behind-desk slip whenever moving an exception book, before treating that move as complete. Retain surname dividers and existing recipient verification; the disturbance remains a defect to prevent.
openings.prediction: Books whose exception locations were updated at movement will have fewer location discrepancies and second searches. Available-hold pickups must still meet the 95% within-two-minutes target, with zero wrong-reader handoffs.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is correcting household-surname placement. If those mismatches chiefly cause repeat searches, current exception entries will not materially reduce delays, and remaining second searches will concentrate on books filed under another household member.
openings.defeat: An evening with accurate exception locations but persistently frequent second searches and more than 5% delayed available-hold pickups would defeat location freshness as a sufficient remedy. Exceeding ten preparation minutes or any wrong-reader handoff defeats task fit.
openings.probe: Propose one bounded evening using the existing clerk, paper, pencils and timing sheet. Record each exception move and its update, check location accuracy behind the desk, and tally retrieval time, second searches and household-name mismatches. Cap all daily preparation at ten clerk-minutes; record incomplete checks as feasibility failure. Keep names and contact details behind the desk and use only the two shelves and cart. Compare with the stipulated baseline without claiming it constitutes a controlled field comparison.
assumptions: Updating movements can fit the preparation cap and evening workload; the eight-minute preparation sample does not verify this.
Existing recipient verification can prevent wrong-reader handoffs; its capability is not established by the fixture.
The eventual intervention is being evaluated; this proposed probe has no observed benefits, and fixture observations are synthetic stipulations.
